note: Literature consistently identifies auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy as the core, hallmark features of FDXR-related disease, with ataxia and motor polyneuropathy occurring in secondary subsets.

evidence.text: A review of 46 reported patients with FDXR variants identified auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy as the most prevalent clinical features alongside secondary manifestations of ataxia and peripheral neuropathy.

source.title: Biallelic FDXR mutations induce ferroptosis in a rare mitochondrial disease with ataxia
source.quote: The most prevalent clinical features included auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy

evidence.text: Initial characterization of biallelic FDXR mutations established auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy as the defining sensorial neuropathies present across all affected individuals in the initial cohort.

source.title: FDXR mutations cause sensorial neuropathies and expand the spectrum of mitochondrial Fe-S-synthesis diseases
source.quote: Here, we report on eight subjects from four independent families affected by auditory neuropathy and optic atrophy.
